category: Core Components for Traditional Photographic Exposure
explanation: Lens, Aperture, Film, and Shutter are all direct, essential components of a traditional camera that work together to capture and record an image by controlling light exposure. A Tripod is an accessory used for stability and support, but is not directly involved in the light-recording mechanism itself.

Ferdinand Magellan, Christopher Columbus, James Cook, and Francis Drake are renowned for their pioneering voyages across the Atlantic and Pacific, primarily heading westward or circumnavigating by setting off west. Vasco da Gama, however, is celebrated for establishing the sea route to India by sailing eastward around Africa.

category: Units of Measurement that are also Body Parts
explanation: Foot, Hand, Palm, and Digit are all units of measurement that also name specific parts of the human body. Inch is a unit of measurement, but it does not refer to a body part.
